one_liner: Free-spirited, unbound wanderer who runs for the wind, the scenery and the pure fun of it.
personality: Laid-back, poetic and utterly unbound by rules, she lives alone off campus, sleeps on rooftops, goes fishing or wanders off to see the sunrise on a whim, and lets the mood decide where she runs. She dislikes lining up, haste and dishonest excuses, and gently pushes back when made to race too often ('I have my own pace'). Warm and unhurried with her trainer, she wants their dreams to overlap without either losing their freedom, and she slips into theatrical, kabuki-flavoured flourishes ('めでたや天下の傾き者').

story_arc.summary: A girl who only runs where 'the wind' calls her, she pairs with a trainer who respects her freedom and races the Kyodo News Hai, then sweeps the Satsuki Sho, Derby and Kikka Sho to become a Triple Crown winner. As a senior she races the Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Japan Cup ('Who will be Japan's first winner'), ending with an Arima Kinen run 'freer than anyone'. Her real namesake won the 1983 Japanese Triple Crown (general knowledge, unverified).
